I suppose this obsoletes #85639 and fixes its linked issues, too?

> I suppose this obsoletes #85639 and fixes its linked issues, too?

Oops, did not see that PR I'm sorry.

Yes it does obsolete that PR and probably fixes the bug

No worries! Just wanted to mention as it's worth adding 'closes x' to the PR description. I have not tested this, but look at the diff I don't think it handles the naming of child sockets correctly? See [this discussion](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/85639#pullrequestreview-1297944589) which is where I got stuck and then forgot about it. :-)
Ah I'll add that ticket tomorrow when I'm back at my pc. For that discussion, I don't think I really follow the problem. This way the entity naming is consistent afaik

So basically it's about having a name based on the child socket on power strips. Here's a screenshot from using this PR in its current state, where individual sockets are indistinguishable from the parent device name: 
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/3705853/9fcd9ddc-ab7c-48db-b5de-3fef8fb67952)

edit: oh, to add, here's how it looks like for that device in the current release:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/3705853/4f476bba-9624-408f-9a0b-241f2a14dea2)
This is now for a socket with 3 outlets (thanks for this screenshot otherwise I wouldnt have guessed why you got 3 switches for only one thin), can there be more?
Yes, there is a HS300 with six sockets available in the US, as well as some devices with just two sockets, too. That's basically why the linked PR included this "hack" for those child devices.
@rytilahti, can you check if this now works like expected?
Oh you probably had to regenerate translations before testing. The reason I am now passing it hardcoded is because there is no other way to translate this at this moment

With the latest change I am not creating separate devices for each plug, it's now creating a switch for every plug and registers it on the strip device. The name of de plug is the name of the child device.
Last commit adds a separate class for the plug to not make it look like a mess. Please let me know what you think!

Note, that changing the device name outside homeassistant will only change the user-visible names inside homeassistant, the existing entities are not renamed (but would be, if you remove and re-add the device).
